assumptions.cooldown: Starts when freeze is applied. Every water hit subtracts 1/15s, each ball impact subtracts 3s. No cap or one-reduction-per-cycle limit.
assumptions.freeze: After cooldown expires, the next ice-cone cast impact freezes for 4s; no additional unknown accumulation threshold.
assumptions.detonation: 0.2s cast; at completion consume all remaining freeze and snapshot bonus. Damage lands 1s later. Lock CD stays 20s.
assumptions.wet: Water lasts 5s, ball 15s; either gives full thunder targeting; dry thunder realizes 50% as an explicit unmeasured assumption.
assumptions.thunder: 120s cooldown from cast start, 2s cast + 1s delay, then off-hand 30s; 0 up-front mana, pay per 1/60s slice, auto-potion allowed; terminate on inability to pay.
assumptions.equipment: Same archived source-config.json as first experiment, 300s no hits, five 30% potions, 2.5% max mana regen +5/s, no nebula mana bridge.
assumptions.status: Design hypotheses, not implemented game mechanics. Coefficients and timing assumptions require in-game confirmation.

checks: Maximal current water spam gives about 30s without a cap; faster attack speed breaks below 30s
Freeze requires an ice hit; each frozen state can be detonated at most once
